scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Power Connection Charges
other_conditions: Enterprise must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise
Enterprise must be run by an SC/ST entrepreneur (SC/ST contribution ≥ 51 %)
Enterprise must be located outside Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC) areas or any approved industrial park
Application for reimbursement must be filed within one year from the date of payment of charges to the distribution licensee
Charges must be paid for a new power connection, additional load for business expansion, or shifting of connection/service line
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 50 % of power connection charges, with a maximum cap of ₹5,00,000.
